decisions.reason: Across the original overlapping exact-state sweep, all required title, subtitle, notice, service labels, details/reason, summary, action and footer text are readable with no ellipsis or missing words; expanded guidance is included only in the expanded state. Character fallback in narrow iOS labels preserves all characters.

Across the complete original exact-state sweep, text, indicators, reason/status content, summary, disclosure content and primary action occupy separate areas without collision or occlusion. Viewport-edge cuts are covered in overlapping original frames.
